name: Energy Impact
author: Nepomuk Software
description: Which processes are drawing power, plus fan, GPU load and temperatures, in the Omarchy bar. Pack watts on battery, RAPL when readable. No root daemon.

barWidget.description: macOS-style 'apps using energy': top processes by CPU share, ~W from battery or RAPL, plus fan RPM and GPU load/temp. Quiet in the bar.

schema.label: Hide on AC
schema.description: Hides the icon while charging or on wall power. The panel is unchanged.

schema.label: Sample interval while open (seconds)
schema.description: How often processes are sampled while the panel is open. Each sample takes under a second.

schema.label: Sample interval while closed (seconds)
schema.description: How often to sample while the panel is closed, so the icon can light up on a hog. Slower on purpose.
